name: Cristina Thunderbolt
original_name: クリスティナ・サンダーボルト
source:
A brutal soldier nicknamed "Destroyer". She does not care for anybody at all, and this aspect of her can quickly become uncontrollable. It seems that she and [url=/c14827]Lorenzo[/url] are a good combination.
